name: ANSI/IEEE Residual-voltage monitoring relay form
summary: IEEE-library form of residual-voltage monitoring relay: a residual-voltage relay responds to the specified residual-voltage measurement.
description: This reference locates residual-voltage monitoring relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented voltage protection relays family. A residual-voltage relay responds to the specified residual-voltage measurement. Its drawing needs the voltage-transformer connection and the input quantity definition. The public library uses HCR1F38 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Check the measurement circuit that produces the residual voltage. Residual voltage is different from phase-to-neutral voltage at an arbitrary single phase. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
